lines.text: Here's how Kai wired his boat. First the muscle, then the brain.
Colored jumper wires carry signals from the brain to the muscle. Every wire goes in its own numbered hole.
Power on! The brain wakes up and makes its own Wi-Fi.
The motors clip in, six double-A batteries plug in... and on the first test, they spin!
Then the upgrades: red, green and yellow lights, two more motors, and a battery gauge.
Into the boat: a yard sign, two bottles zip-tied under it, and the brain in a to-go box.
Four motors tilt forty-five degrees, spinning steel rods down to the propellers.
Flip the switch... and go! Built by Kai.
